claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Talniflumate is a poorly soluble, non-cytotoxic NSAID-like prodrug with no plausible cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any killing would reflect nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared targeted mechanism.
